method: Export independent catalog cases through ordinary sim.structure without cost execution or profiler-derived tensors. Probe tokens=1 is a declared metadata exercise, not a captured run geometry. Source layer plans and operator contract families are retained verbatim.

interpretation.layer_context: node.structure describes the originating layer; it does not make every node an attention, FFN or residual kernel.
interpretation.contracted_nodes: A non-null declared tensor contract can be compared; it is not evidence the operator was measured or every condition was observed.
interpretation.subgraph_roles: Composite boundaries cover their members once; they do not add a second copy of work or per-member measured time.
interpretation.replicas: Node counts may include multiple representative DP replicas; layer_plan_groups count model layers once.

terminology_source.csa: Low compression (default4), overlapping compression and Lightning Indexer top-k selection.
terminology_source.hca: High compression (default128), non-overlapping compression without an indexer, attending all pooled entries.
terminology_source.application: Use architecture/cache-kind/compression/indexer fields together; do not infer CSA/HCA only from a numerical ratio. V4.1 shared-compression1/2 is reported in its own raw terms.
